# Decision Memory

## Procedure
Use `scripts/shortslab.py decision` and `experiment`; log evidence links, unknowns, alternatives, and follow-up. Query SQLite before revisiting a topic.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
